question: I maintain tokio-rs/tokio and I'm deciding whether to spend time on CI. Did the share of commits on the default branch that fail the CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) change between H1 and H2? How often did a failing run pass just because someone re-ran it? For each commit, use the run from when it landed on the default branch (its earliest push run of that workflow), with its final result. Count each commit once, and leave out cancelled and skipped runs. A failing run means a result of failure, timed_out or startup_failure. All dates are in UTC. The window is 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-20. H1 is 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31 and H2 is 2026-04-01 to 2026-09-20, both inclusive.
